entities.name: Sarmiza Bilcescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sarmiza or Sarmisegetuza or Sarmisa Bilcescu was a Romanian lawyer, the first woman ever to study law and obtain a PhD in law from the Faculty of Law of Paris, and the first female lawyer in her country.
